violations.msg: Charger (196 mA from R3 5.1k) starts at plug-in with no enumeration gate, and system peak (~450 mA WiFi TX) adds to it, so VBUS draw can reach ~650 mA against the 100 mA pre-enumeration / 500 mA default-USB entitlement; a weak host or hub can brown out VBUS and reset the module mid-flash (firmware should cap TX power or charge current, or R3 go to ~10k).

SMF5.0A clamps up to 9.2 V at rated surge and breaks down at 6.4-7.0 V, above the MCP73831 VDD abs max of 7.0 V and next to 16 V X5R C1, so a hot-plug spike can stress U2 before the TVS clamps; low risk for a 5 V bench source but not margin for a product.

J2 has no reverse-insertion protection and cheap LiPo packs often use the opposite JST-PH polarity, so a reversed cell drives VBAT negative into U2/Q1/the divider and destroys U2; accepted default (requirements 1e) but only safe if silk marks pin 1 = + visibly after assembly and the BOM states the pack polarity.

U3 dissipates ~0.32 W at 4.9 V VSYS with 450 mA peak (theta-JA 230 C/W gives Tj ~114 C at 40 C ambient, 125 C max); fine for duty-cycled WiFi, but sustained TX on USB leaves almost no margin, so layout needs the planned GND pour and vias.

IO2, IO8 (and IO9 via none) strapping pins are routed to the J4 edge pads; anything a user attaches that pulls IO2/IO8 low at reset changes boot mode, and the 10k pull-ups are the only defence; J4 is DNP so this is a documentation risk only.

Cannot confirm from the schematic that TS-1187A-B-A-B internally shorts pins 1-2 and 3-4 (as the symbol assumes); if the real pairing is 1-3/2-4 the switch is permanently closed, pulling EN (SW1) and IO9 (SW2) to GND and the module never boots; verify against the switch datasheet and footprint before ordering (no switch datasheet is in parts/).
